strings.name: Euisun Chung
strings.role: Automotive executive · Hyundai Motor Group executive chair
strings.summary: After business studies, Chung worked across Hyundai, led Kia and served as Hyundai vice chairman before becoming group chair in 2020. He promoted premium brands, electric vehicles, hydrogen and robotics while expanding global manufacturing. The group acquired control of Boston Dynamics and developed US electric-vehicle production; technologies and products reflect company teams and partners.
strings.coverageNote: Selected verifiable milestones through 13 November 2026; not a real-time news archive.
strings.influence.rationale: Led Hyundai Motor Group, advancing electric vehicles, hydrogen energy and global manufacturing.
strings.facts.f1.label: Birth
strings.facts.f2.label: Education
strings.facts.f2.value: Business-administration bachelor’s, Korea University(1993); MBA, San Francisco(1997).
strings.highlights.h1.title: Automotive transformation
strings.highlights.h1.text: Promoted electric vehicles, hydrogen and premium brands, redirecting the group’s development.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Robotics and manufacturing
strings.highlights.h2.text: The group acquired control of Boston Dynamics and expanded electric-vehicle manufacturing.
strings.timeline.t1.title: US electric-vehicle plant
strings.timeline.t1.text: Attended the opening of Georgia’s Hyundai Metaplant, expanding US EV manufacturing.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Boston Dynamics acquisition
strings.timeline.t2.text: The group completed its controlling-stake acquisition; SoftBank retained a minority interest.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Group executive chair
strings.timeline.t3.text: Advanced from executive vice chairman, succeeding his father Chung Mong-koo.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Executive vice chairman
strings.timeline.t4.text: Took responsibility for group-wide operations and transformation.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Genesis brand
strings.timeline.t5.text: Helped develop Genesis as a separate luxury automotive brand.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Hyundai vice chairman
strings.timeline.t6.text: Moved from Kia’s presidency to Hyundai’s vice chairmanship.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Kia president
strings.timeline.t7.text: Led operations and changes in brand and design direction.
strings.timeline.t8.title: MBA
strings.timeline.t8.text: Completed the University of San Francisco MBA.
